messages:
Sam Warren: Heads-up: we're doing a short CI auth migration next Wed 09:00 PT — replacing repo PATs with OIDC tokens and a `ci-service` account for non-workflow automation. Full runbook: https://runbook.internal/redwood/ci-auth-migration :loud_sound:
Jess Li: Quick ask — can we get a one-page checklist for repo owners? I want to ping owners tomorrow.
Sam Warren: Sure. Short checklist: 1) search for GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_PAT in workflows and scripts; 2) convert workflows to use OIDC (example in runbook); 3) for external scripts, switch to `ci-service` secrets or proxy through automation-bot; 4) join the preflight Tue 16:00 PT.
Ravi Kumar: For self-hosted runners that use org-level tokens, any config flags to change?
Sam Warren: Update runner config to enable OIDC audience and ensure the KMS secrets agent is running. See runbook section "self-hosted" for the exact env vars.
Infra Bot: infra playbook triggered: infra/sa-rotation (owner: infra-team)
Maya Ortiz: I'll run an automation-bot audit and post repos that need changes by EOD.
Jess Li: I'll coordinate owner pings and include the checklist. Thanks! :thumbsup:
